title: Alien reproduction vehicle pilot and pilot manager at Edwards

tellings.quote: We have a whistleblower who's flown uh an alien reproduction vehicle, a UFO that we've seen. And more importantly, the man who managed all the pilots who flew them out of Edwards Air Force Base Edwards complex.

plain: A whistleblower says he flew an 'alien reproduction vehicle', meaning a human-built craft copied from a UFO, and a second man says he managed all the pilots who flew such craft out of Edwards Air Force Base in California. The UFO researcher Steven Greer describes both witnesses on Michels' show, relaying what they told him. If true, it would mean the US was flying copied alien craft.
